coinSvgAssets.note: Original flat drawings with their own colours, rim, ring and numeral. They have no common-side map, stars, national side or relief, following the Commission non-relief route (RESEARCH R3). This is not a legal opinion. Store them as inline string constants in app/js/mg_shop.js. They use no ids, masks or gradients, so repeated copies are safe. Text uses the bundled Andika font, not Arial.

rounds.covers: pay 5, get 2 back; pay 6, get 3; pay 7, get 4; 1+1 is too little
2+2 is exact (no change); pay 5, get 1 back; pay 7, get 3; pay 9, get 5
€2 is too little; pay €4, get €1 back
2+2 is exact (no change); pay €6, get €2 back

passport.rounds: 4 find rounds. The wallet holds one value card per denomination, in shuffled positions, with no till. Prices follow DENOMS[cur] in the order [d2, d0, d3, d1].
